about.title: About TREND Coffee
about.description: Trend Coffee is a rustic-inspired space where the aroma of freshly roasted beans blends with warm, welcoming vibes. Every detail—from raw wooden tables and gentle amber lighting to the scent of new roasts—is carefully curated to feel like a familiar corner of the city.
about.description2: Each drink or dish is crafted with wholehearted dedication, from ingredient selection and preparation to heartfelt service.
about.visionDescription: Become a beloved and trusted food-and-beverage brand where every guest discovers a personal "familiar corner"—a place where flavors, feelings, and people come together.
about.missionDescription: Share the culture of coffee and cuisine with a “care in every product” spirit. Create a space that connects people, work, and emotions so every guest feels valued. Grow sustainably with quality ingredients, thoughtful service, and memorable experiences.
about.featuredServicesDescription1: Trend Coffee offers a broad selection of specialty coffee, tea, and handmade pastries.
about.featuredServicesDescription2: Each cup balances flavor and feeling—from rich espresso to refreshing tea, everything is brewed with intention.
about.featuredServicesDescription3: Beyond beverages, Trend Coffee serves a variety of light bites and hearty dishes for any time of day.
about.featuredServicesDescription4: We support birthdays, meetups, workshops, and mini events with flexible spaces, custom menus, and a professional service team.
about.featuredServicesDescription5: Trend Coffee hosts creative workshops and community sessions—painting, candle making, craft coffee, photography talks, and more—with cozy, inspiring setups and full logistical support.
about.featuredServicesDescription6: We deliver the best services for you.
